specs.title: SPDK/DPDK Environment Component with VFIO Device Iteration

drifted.spec_text: The component discovers 100% of available (not in-use) VFIO-bound devices on a properly configured system, matching the devices visible in /sys/bus/pci/drivers/vfio-pci minus those locked by other processes.
drifted.actual: enumerate_devices() only calls spdk_pci_enumerate() against the driver returned by spdk_pci_get_driver("nvme"), so only NVMe-class VFIO devices are ever discovered. virtio-blk and other SPDK-supported device types bound to vfio-pci are never enumerated, contradicting the 'all VFIO-bound devices' claim.

drifted.spec_text: On a misconfigured system (no VFIO, wrong permissions, no hugepages, missing logger), the component reports the specific issue within its first error message...
drifted.actual: There is no logger receptacle in the implementation (per FR-007/Clarifications), so 'missing logger' is not a possible error condition. SC-002's text was not updated after the logger receptacle was removed from scope.

drifted.spec_text: The component produces structured log messages through the framework's logging system during initialization and device discovery, including warnings for skipped devices.
drifted.actual: All diagnostics use bare eprintln!() macro calls (unstructured, not routed through the component-framework logging actor), directly per FR-007 ('there is no logger receptacle'). SC-005 directly contradicts FR-007 in the same spec.

drifted.requirement: Edge Case: "SPDK/DPDK initialization fails mid-way (partial initialization cleanup)"
drifted.spec_text: The component cleans up any partially initialized state and returns an error from init().
drifted.actual: do_init() only clears the SPDK_ENV_ACTIVE singleton flag when do_init_inner() errors; it never calls spdk_sys::spdk_env_fini() to unwind a successful init_spdk_env() if a later step were to fail. This path is currently unreachable because enumerate_devices() is written to always return Ok(..) (SpdkEnvError::DeviceProbeFailed is defined in interfaces but never constructed here), but the cleanup logic the spec describes does not exist.

not_implemented: FR-015: 'skip devices that cannot be probed ... log a warning ... return only successfully probed devices' — the FR text itself flags this as future work ('Future: not yet implemented. Currently all matching devices are claimed...'), and no such skip/retry logic exists in enumerate_devices(). Acceptance Scenario 4 of User Story 1 (spec.md:33) still describes this as working today, which is inconsistent with FR-015's own caveat.

unspecced.feature: DmaBuffer: DMA-safe buffer allocation/lifecycle API (new(), from_raw(), Deref/DerefMut, Drop-time SPDK deallocation gated by a process-global active flag)
unspecced.location: components/spdk-env/src/dma.rs:6 (re-export); components/interfaces/src/spdk_types.rs:177-420 (definition); coordination flag set in components/spdk-env/src/env.rs:102,191
unspecced.suggested_spec: Add a User Story / FR set to 002-spdk-env-vfio-init (or a new spec) covering DmaBuffer's allocation contract, from_raw() safety obligations, and the set_spdk_env_active() coordination protocol that prevents SPDK deallocators from running after spdk_env_fini().

unspecced.feature: Explicit fini() teardown method on ISPDKEnv, for callers that must detach NVMe controllers / free DMA buffers before dropping the component
unspecced.suggested_spec: Add an FR describing the explicit fini() lifecycle step and its precondition (all NVMe controllers detached / DMA buffers freed first), distinct from the implicit Drop-based cleanup already covered by FR-012.

unspecced.feature: Operator/dev-ops shell scripts for VFIO binding, kernel boot params, permission setup, and dnf cache repair (bind_vfio.sh interactive/status/bind/reset/bind-all/reset-all workflow, add_kernel_options.sh grubby IOMMU/hugepage flags, cfg_user_spdk.sh chmod of /dev/vfio and /dev/hugepages, show_spdk_devices.sh listing)
unspecced.suggested_spec: Document these as sanctioned operator setup tooling in 002-spdk-env-vfio-init's Assumptions section, which currently says binding/hugepages are 'performed externally' without naming these scripts.

conflicts.description: Clarifications session answer ('All SPDK-supported device types bound to VFIO (NVMe, virtio-blk, etc.)') and User Story 1 narrative ('probes for all SPDK-supported device types (NVMe, virtio-blk, etc.)') contradict FR-006, which explicitly narrows scope to NVMe-only enumeration via spdk_pci_enumerate with the NVMe PCI driver. The implementation follows the narrower FR-006, not the Clarifications answer or User Story 1 text.

Supporting design artifacts contracts/ispdk-env.md and data-model.md were not updated when the logger receptacle was removed from spec.md via clarification. They still document a `logger: ILogger` receptacle, a construct->connect(logger)->init() usage contract, and a `SpdkEnvError::LoggerNotConnected` variant/state-transition, none of which exist in the code or in the current spec.md (which explicitly annotates '(Removed: no logger receptacle exists in the implementation.)').
